parts.name: double yoke forging

physics.Basic_description: Central grey metallic block connecting the two shafts, featuring machined surfaces and bearing caps.
physics.Functional_description: The main structural component of the double cardan joint that houses the centering mechanism and connects the yokes.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the central body firmly between parallel jaws, avoiding the rotating caps.
physics.reason: Forged steel component with internal cavities for the centering ball and spider journals to reduce weight while maintaining strength.

parts.description: Central grey metallic block connecting the two shafts, featuring machined surfaces and bearing caps.

parts.name: centering socket

physics.Basic_description: Small internal metallic cup or recess visible within the center assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Receives the centering ball to maintain constant velocity alignment between the shafts.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to grasp directly; part of the internal mechanism.
physics.reason: Small hardened steel insert designed to withstand high contact pressure from the ball.

parts.description: Small internal metallic cup or recess visible within the center assembly.

parts.name: centering ball

physics.Basic_description: Spherical metallic component located at the very center of the joint assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Pivots within the socket to ensure the input and output shafts bisect the operating angle.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, not accessible for grasping without disassembly.
physics.reason: Solid steel ball bearing element required for load transmission.

parts.description: Spherical metallic component located at the very center of the joint assembly.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
